case.summary: Transaction 3553342 ($30.91) on card C05876-K2 was flagged by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.55, but the bank's calibrated model scored it at 0.008 with a historical fraud rate of 0.6%. The purchase was an in-person transaction in region 494, where the cardholder already has an established history of 21 prior transactions. Analysis of 106 transactions across the two-week card window revealed no suspicious activity, card testing, or device anomalies. Regional shared origin analysis confirmed a low fraud lift of 0.3 with no associated fraud rings or customer disputes. The alert is confirmed to be a false alarm, and the transaction is cleared as legitimate.
